records.label: Endpoint Name / Stable Key / Description
records.notes: Stable generated key and required name; key never changes after publish so dependencies/import refs stay valid. Evidence: docs/MODULES/REST-API-BUILDER-EXHAUSTIVE-SPEC.md §4.

records.label: Namespace / Version Segment / Route Pattern & Collision Rules
records.notes: Maps to register_rest_route() namespace/route grammar; WPE adds reserved-namespace, duplicate method+route and unique path-parameter validation. Evidence: docs/MODULES/REST-API-BUILDER-EXHAUSTIVE-SPEC.md §4.

records.label: HTTP Methods & Read/Write/Destructive Operation Class
records.notes: GET/POST/PUT/PATCH/DELETE per binding semantics; HEAD/OPTIONS follow WordPress; GET must never perform a state-changing action. Evidence: docs/MODULES/REST-API-BUILDER-EXHAUSTIVE-SPEC.md §5.

records.label: Draft / Enabled / Disabled / Archived / Delete Impact
records.notes: Draft default; disabled/archived routes return safe unavailable/not-found without deleting data; delete shows dependency/usage/log impact and published-public warning. Evidence: docs/MODULES/REST-API-BUILDER-EXHAUSTIVE-SPEC.md §4, §33.

records.label: Binding Type (Query / Data Source / CRUD Ability / Workflow / Registered Ability / Certified SDK Provider)
records.notes: Execution stays with the canonical owner (Query S6, Data Source owner, Ability owner, Workflow S17); Surface 22 owns only the endpoint definition. Evidence: docs/MODULES/REST-API-BUILDER-EXHAUSTIVE-SPEC.md §6.

records.label: Ability Input/Output Mapping (Static / Path / Query / Body / Principal / Site Context)
records.notes: Endpoint maps typed inputs into the Ability input schema and output through the response schema; it cannot override the Ability permission callback with weaker policy; secret refs only when the Ability accepts them internally. Evidence: docs/MODULES/REST-API-BUILDER-EXHAUSTIVE-SPEC.md §20.

records.label: Route Parameters (Type / Validation / Pattern / Mapping)
records.notes: Native REST args/validate_callback substrate. Route parameter is data, not authorization; object-level Policy rechecks the resolved resource. Evidence: docs/MODULES/REST-API-BUILDER-EXHAUSTIVE-SPEC.md §7.

records.label: Query Parameters (Type / Required / Default / Enum / Range / Pattern / Sensitive)
records.notes: Native args schema; reserved/global WordPress REST parameters must not be shadowed without explicit compatibility handling. Evidence: docs/MODULES/REST-API-BUILDER-EXHAUSTIVE-SPEC.md §8.

records.label: Allowlisted Custom Header Inputs
records.notes: Only allowlisted custom headers map to inputs; Authorization/Cookie/internal proxy headers are never user-mappable; Idempotency-Key may be first-class. Evidence: docs/MODULES/REST-API-BUILDER-EXHAUSTIVE-SPEC.md §9.

records.label: JSON Request Body Schema / Nested Limits / Strict Unknown-Property Policy
records.notes: Native JSON Schema validation substrate; strict unknown-property rejection is the default candidate for writes; bounded depth/items; never blind mass assignment. Evidence: docs/MODULES/REST-API-BUILDER-EXHAUSTIVE-SPEC.md §10.

records.label: Registered File Upload Input (Count / Bytes / MIME Allowlist / Storage Policy)
records.notes: WordPress upload/security policies apply (wp_handle_upload substrate); private/public storage policy delegated to Media/S03; no arbitrary server path. Evidence: docs/MODULES/REST-API-BUILDER-EXHAUSTIVE-SPEC.md §11.

records.label: Same-Site Cookie + REST Nonce
records.notes: Default for authenticated WPE application calls; native wp_rest nonce CSRF protection. Evidence: docs/MODULES/REST-API-BUILDER-EXHAUSTIVE-SPEC.md §12.

records.label: WordPress Application Passwords (HTTPS)
records.notes: Baseline external machine/client authentication where HTTPS and core support apply. Evidence: docs/MODULES/REST-API-BUILDER-EXHAUSTIVE-SPEC.md §12.

records.label: Registered OAuth / JWT / Custom Auth Adapter
records.notes: Future certified adapter only after separate security review; provider lifecycle belongs to Surface 23 Connections or a certified adapter. Evidence: docs/MODULES/REST-API-BUILDER-EXHAUSTIVE-SPEC.md §12.

records.label: Required Permission Policy Mode (Public Read / Authenticated / Capability / Resource Policy / Owner / Membership / Registered Provider)
records.notes: Every endpoint requires explicit permission_callback semantics evaluated in order: context, site boundary, capability, resource Policy, Membership, business guards; no frontend-only authorization. Evidence: docs/MODULES/REST-API-BUILDER-EXHAUSTIVE-SPEC.md §13.

records.label: Public Endpoint Safeguards (Rate / Anti-Abuse / Payload & Result Limits / Field Allowlist / Enumeration Warning)
records.notes: Public is an explicit policy, never a missing callback; PII/private fields prohibited unless explicit secure use case; public write needs high-risk confirmation + abuse model. Evidence: docs/MODULES/REST-API-BUILDER-EXHAUSTIVE-SPEC.md §14.

records.label: Explicit Response Schema (Key / Source / Type / Nullable / Formatter / Include Condition / Sensitivity)
records.notes: Never returns full WP object/user/meta by default; protected/internal fields need explicit allowlisting + policy. Evidence: docs/MODULES/REST-API-BUILDER-EXHAUSTIVE-SPEC.md §15.

records.label: Page / Cursor Pagination, Default & Max Page Size, Total Count, Offset Limit
records.notes: Aligns with native page/per_page and X-WP-Total/X-WP-TotalPages headers; cursor only where the Data Source supports stable cursors; no per_page=all. Evidence: docs/MODULES/REST-API-BUILDER-EXHAUSTIVE-SPEC.md §16.

records.label: Predefined Filters (Operator Allowlist / Max Items) & Allowlisted Sort Keys
records.notes: Filters map into Query AST/Data Source schema; client orderby is never mapped to raw SQL identifiers. Evidence: docs/MODULES/REST-API-BUILDER-EXHAUSTIVE-SPEC.md §17.

records.label: Sparse Field Selection (_fields) Within Allowed Schema
records.notes: Native _fields global parameter; restricted to already-allowed response schema and never reveals hidden fields; may be disabled for fixed payloads. Evidence: docs/MODULES/REST-API-BUILDER-EXHAUSTIVE-SPEC.md §18.

records.label: Explicit Relation Embeds (Allowed Fields / Max Depth / Max Rows / Related Policy)
records.notes: Native _embed/_links substrate; WPE requires explicit embed definitions with related-object Policy and bounded depth to avoid N+1 and leaks. Evidence: docs/MODULES/REST-API-BUILDER-EXHAUSTIVE-SPEC.md §19.

records.label: Create / Update / Delete Semantics (Field Allowlist / Partial vs Full / Preconditions / Trash vs Permanent)
records.notes: Create field allowlist and 201/Location candidate; update optimistic version/ETag precondition candidate; delete trash vs permanent and cascade policy with server capability always required. Evidence: docs/MODULES/REST-API-BUILDER-EXHAUSTIVE-SPEC.md §21.

records.label: Idempotency-Key (Principal-Scoped / Retention / Request-Hash Conflict / Stored Result)
records.notes: Not a native WordPress REST feature; WPE-exceed for create, external side-effect workflow, membership and payment-adjacent writes; key reuse with different hash returns 409. Evidence: docs/MODULES/REST-API-BUILDER-EXHAUSTIVE-SPEC.md §22.

records.label: Rate-Limit Profile (None-Internal / Standard / Strict Public / Custom Bounded) & Dimensions
records.notes: Dimensions: principal/application, IP with trusted-proxy rules, endpoint, site; Retry-After/headers. Endpoint chooses a profile; shared rate service (Surface 27) owns storage/algorithm. Evidence: docs/MODULES/REST-API-BUILDER-EXHAUSTIVE-SPEC.md §23.

records.label: CORS Policy (Exact Origins / Methods / Headers / Credentials / Max Age)
records.notes: Default same-origin with no permissive headers; scheme/host/port validated; preflight tested; CORS never replaces authentication/authorization. Evidence: docs/MODULES/REST-API-BUILDER-EXHAUSTIVE-SPEC.md §24.

records.label: Response Cache (Disabled / Public / Private-Per-User, TTL, Key Dimensions, Invalidation, ETag)
records.notes: Disabled by default for personalized/protected writes; permission-dependent responses never cached under a shared key. Evidence: docs/MODULES/REST-API-BUILDER-EXHAUSTIVE-SPEC.md §25.

records.label: HTTP Status Mapping & Stable Safe Error Envelope
records.notes: 200/201/204/400/401/403/404/409/413/422/429/5xx mapping; envelope with stable code, safe message, field errors, correlation ID, retry hint; never SQL, stack traces, paths, secrets or provider credentials. Evidence: docs/MODULES/REST-API-BUILDER-EXHAUSTIVE-SPEC.md §26, §27.

records.label: Versioning / Breaking-Change Warning / Deprecation Window / Replacement Link
records.notes: No silent breaking schema change to a published endpoint; deprecation date/status, replacement endpoint and local-only usage telemetry. Evidence: docs/MODULES/REST-API-BUILDER-EXHAUSTIVE-SPEC.md §28.

records.label: Schema-Driven Endpoint Docs & OpenAPI-Like Export
records.notes: Docs generated from endpoint schema with synthetic/redacted examples only; OpenAPI-like export after schema stabilizes. Evidence: docs/MODULES/REST-API-BUILDER-EXHAUSTIVE-SPEC.md §29.

records.label: Admin Test Console (Current/Anonymous Context, Dry-Run, Safe Policy Trace)
records.notes: Admin-only; no impersonation of higher-privilege users without dedicated test-as capability/re-auth; public endpoints may test anonymously. Evidence: docs/MODULES/REST-API-BUILDER-EXHAUSTIVE-SPEC.md §30.

records.label: Request Log Metadata, Optional Redacted Debug Payload, Retention & Sampling
records.notes: Metadata-first (request ID, endpoint revision, principal summary, status, duration, bytes, rate outcome); debug payload off by default and redacted; per-class retention, cleanup job, sampling for high-volume public endpoints. Evidence: docs/MODULES/REST-API-BUILDER-EXHAUSTIVE-SPEC.md §31, §32.

records.label: Global Defaults & Safety Caps (Namespace Prefix / Version / Max Body / Max Page / Rate Profile / CORS None / Execution Budget)
records.notes: Safety caps cannot be disabled by an ordinary module editor. Evidence: docs/MODULES/REST-API-BUILDER-EXHAUSTIVE-SPEC.md §34.

records.label: Builder Management Capabilities & Abilities (incl. AI Exposure Defaults)
records.notes: Separate capabilities for read/create/publish/test/logs/diagnostics/CORS-rate profiles and a dedicated high-risk public-write capability; runtime endpoint permission is endpoint Policy, not builder capability; AI publish/public-write/CORS-widening/destructive binding disabled by default. Evidence: docs/MODULES/REST-API-BUILDER-EXHAUSTIVE-SPEC.md §35, §36.

records.label: Lifecycle/Security Events & Degraded-State Diagnostics
records.notes: Published/enabled/deprecated and deduped denied/rate-limited events; no event per successful request; diagnostics for missing binding, auth adapter, invalid Policy/CORS, rate-store degraded, REST disabled by host/security plugin, Pro expiry per ADR-0007. Evidence: docs/MODULES/REST-API-BUILDER-EXHAUSTIVE-SPEC.md §37, §38.

records.label: Request/Body/Depth/Page/Query-Cost/Time/Response-Byte Budgets & Async Offload
records.notes: Long operations return a job/run resource instead of holding the request; no N+1 embeds; runtime endpoints add no frontend assets (§40). Evidence: docs/MODULES/REST-API-BUILDER-EXHAUSTIVE-SPEC.md §39.

records.label: Site/Network Route Scope, Dependency References & Import/Export Mapping
records.notes: Per-site route scope via get_rest_url substrate; package movement delegated to Surface 26 Import/Export with dependency refs and conflict/deprecation mapping. Evidence: docs/MODULES/REST-API-BUILDER-EXHAUSTIVE-SPEC.md §13 (site/network boundary), §38; docs/PRODUCT/REST-API-BANK-ENTRY-READINESS-V1.md family 24.

records.label: Raw SQL / Arbitrary PHP / Filesystem Path Execution or Client SQL Identifiers
records.notes: Rejected: market no-code SQL endpoint builders are not evidence to accept raw SQL/PHP/filesystem execution or client-controlled orderby identifiers. Evidence: docs/MODULES/REST-API-BUILDER-EXHAUSTIVE-SPEC.md §1, §6, §17.

records.label: Missing / Implicit Permission Callback ("Public" as Absent Policy)
records.notes: Rejected: WordPress itself warns on missing permission_callback; every WPE endpoint needs explicit policy. Evidence: docs/MODULES/REST-API-BUILDER-EXHAUSTIVE-SPEC.md §1, §12, §13.

records.label: Weak Static Bearer Token / API Key as Default Authentication
records.notes: Rejected as a default; stronger adapters only through certified Surface 23/auth adapters after security review. Evidence: docs/MODULES/REST-API-BUILDER-EXHAUSTIVE-SPEC.md §12.

records.label: Arbitrary Authorization / Cookie / Internal Proxy Header Mapping
records.notes: Rejected: credentials/proxy headers are never dynamic user-mappable inputs. Evidence: docs/MODULES/REST-API-BUILDER-EXHAUSTIVE-SPEC.md §9.

records.label: Mass Assignment, Raw Object/Meta Dumps, per_page=all and Unrestricted Recursive Embeds
records.notes: Rejected: request bodies never map blindly; responses are explicit, bounded and Policy-filtered. Evidence: docs/MODULES/REST-API-BUILDER-EXHAUSTIVE-SPEC.md §10, §15, §16, §19.

records.label: Wildcard CORS With Credentials / Arbitrary Origin Mirroring
records.notes: Rejected: exact origin list only. Evidence: docs/MODULES/REST-API-BUILDER-EXHAUSTIVE-SPEC.md §24.

records.label: Shared Cache of Permission-Dependent Responses
records.notes: Rejected: cross-user leakage risk. Evidence: docs/MODULES/REST-API-BUILDER-EXHAUSTIVE-SPEC.md §25.

records.label: Public Write Enabled by a Single Casual Toggle
records.notes: Rejected: public write requires dedicated capability, explicit high-risk confirmation and abuse model. Evidence: docs/MODULES/REST-API-BUILDER-EXHAUSTIVE-SPEC.md §14, §35.

records.label: Logging Raw Bodies, Authorization Headers, Cookies, Application Passwords or Secrets
records.notes: Rejected: metadata-first logs and synthetic/redacted doc examples only. Evidence: docs/MODULES/REST-API-BUILDER-EXHAUSTIVE-SPEC.md §31, §29.

records.label: Test Console Privilege Impersonation Without Dedicated Capability/Re-Auth
records.notes: Rejected. Evidence: docs/MODULES/REST-API-BUILDER-EXHAUSTIVE-SPEC.md §30.

coverage.notes: All 46 REST API records are classified from docs/MODULES/REST-API-BUILDER-EXHAUSTIVE-SPEC.md and docs/PRODUCT/REST-API-BANK-ENTRY-READINESS-V1.md. Native WordPress REST primitives are transport/validation substrate only; endpoint Policy is mandatory; idempotency and versioning/deprecation are WPE-exceed; third-party auth adapters are deferred; 10 unsafe patterns stay rejected.
